q1.explanationZh: where 作副词问“在哪里”，作连词引导地点从句“在……的地方”。

q2.explanationZh: where 加 -ever 表示“无论在哪里”，= no matter where。

q3.explanationZh: whether 表示“是否”，whether...or...“不管……还是……”。注意拼写 wh-e-ther。

q4.explanationZh: which 在一定范围内问“哪一个；哪一些”，可作代词和形容词。

q5.explanationZh: which 加 -ever 表示“无论哪个”，= no matter which。

q6.explanationZh: while 作连词表示“当……时；虽然；然而”，作名词表示“一会儿”，如 for a while。

q7.explanationZh: whip 名词“鞭子”，动词“鞭打”，过去式双写 p：whipped。

q8.explanationZh: whisper“低语，耳语”，in a whisper“低声地”。

q9.explanationZh: whistle“口哨；吹口哨”，注意 t 不发音。

q10.explanationZh: white 既是形容词“白色的”，也是名词“白色”。

q12.explanationZh: who 加 -ever 表示“无论谁”，= no matter who（引导名词性从句时 = anyone who）。

q13.explanationZh: whole“整个的；全部”，开头有不发音的 w，别和 hole“洞”混淆。

q14.explanationZh: who 的宾格是 whom，在句中作宾语。

q15.explanationZh: whose“谁的”，是 who 的所有格。

q17.explanationZh: wide 形容词“宽的；广泛的”，也可作副词“张得很大地”，如 open wide。

q18.explanationZh: wide 加 -ly 构成副词 widely“广泛地”，多用于抽象意义，如 be widely used。

q19.explanationZh: widespread = wide + spread（散布），“分布广的；普遍的”。

q20.explanationZh: wide 的名词是 width“宽度”，注意结尾 -dth。

q21.explanationZh: wife“妻子”，以 -fe 结尾的名词变复数把 -fe 改成 -ves：wife → wives。

q22.explanationZh: Wi-Fi“无线网络”，注意大写 W、F 和中间的连字符。

q23.explanationZh: wild“野生的；荒芜的；狂热的”，be wild with joy“欣喜若狂”。

q24.explanationZh: wild 加 -er-ness 构成 wilderness“荒野”，注意前面读 /ˈwɪl/。

q25.explanationZh: wildlife = wild + life，“野生动物（总称）”，不可数。

q26.explanationZh: will 作助动词“将；会”，作名词“意志；遗嘱”。

q27.explanationZh: willing“愿意的”，be willing to do sth.“乐意做某事”。

q28.explanationZh: willing 加 -ly 构成副词 willingly“乐意地”。

q29.explanationZh: win“赢得（比赛、奖项）”，过去式 won。

q30.explanationZh: wind 读 /wɪnd/ 是名词“风”，读 /waɪnd/ 是动词“缠绕；蜿蜒”，拼写相同。

q32.explanationZh: after a while“过了一会儿”，while 作名词“一会儿”。

q33.explanationZh: for a while“一会儿，一段时间”。

q34.explanationZh: once in a while“偶尔”，字面是“在一段时间里有一次”。

q35.explanationZh: punish sb. with a whip“用鞭子惩罚某人”，with 表示用工具。

accept: to speak in a whisper/in whispers

q36.explanationZh: in a whisper / in whispers“低声地”，speak in a whisper“低声说话”。

q37.explanationZh: widespread“分布广的”，a widespread disease 指传播很广的疾病。

q38.explanationZh: wildlife“野生动物”，a wildlife zoo“野生动物园”。

q39.explanationZh: be willing to do sth.“乐意做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

q42.explanationZh: win award“赢得奖励（奖学金）”，win 后接奖项、荣誉。

q44.explanationZh: win a prize“获奖”，win 后接奖项。

q45.explanationZh: be widely accepted“被广泛接受”，副词 widely 修饰过去分词 accepted。

q46.explanationZh: be widely used“被广泛使用”，被动语态 be + 过去分词。

q47.explanationZh: “测量窗户的全宽”，the full 后接名词，wide 的名词是 width。

q48.explanationZh: “老师吹响哨子开始赛跑”，blew a 后接名词单数 whistle“哨子”。

q49.explanationZh: 从句缺 wait for 的宾语，指人，用宾格 whom。

q50.explanationZh: 问“谁会赢”，缺主语，用 who；do you think 是插入语，句首大写 Who。

q51.explanationZh: “他鞭打马让它跑快”，讲过去的事用过去式，whip 双写 p 加 -ed：whipped。

q52.explanationZh: 谚语 Will is power.“意志就是力量”，will 作名词“意志”。

q53.explanationZh: leave 后缺宾语，指“出生长大的地方”，用 where 引导宾语从句，= the place where。

q54.explanationZh: “这个故事正在街坊里私下流传”，is being + 过去分词是现在进行时的被动语态，用 whispered。

q55.explanationZh: will 后接动词原形，win the game“赢得比赛”。

q56.explanationZh: the reason 后的定语从句缺原因状语，用关系副词 why。

q57.sampleAnswer: The movie Soul imagines how our personalities are created at a cartoony summer camp, where happy little balls and lines come together to form the human soul.
references: The movie Soul imagines how our personalities are created at a cartoony summer camp, where happy little balls and lines come together to form the human soul.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “在那里”指前面的 summer camp，用非限制性定语从句 , where...；“聚集在一起”= come together。

q58.sampleAnswer: Not well managed, the museum, whose exhibits are dusty and hall deserted, requires immediate improvement.
references: Not well managed, the museum, whose exhibits are dusty and hall deserted, requires immediate improvement.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “博物馆的展品”用 whose 引导非限制性定语从句；Not well managed 是过去分词短语作原因状语。

q59.sampleAnswer: Why not go to the botanic garden for a picnic this Saturday when we have such nice weather?
references: Why not go to the botanic garden for a picnic this Saturday when we have such nice weather?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: 提建议用 Why not + 动词原形；“野餐”= go for a picnic；“植物园”= botanic garden。

q60.sampleAnswer: Whoever has never experienced several failures can hardly feel the happiness of success.
references: Whoever has never experienced several failures can hardly feel the happiness of success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: Whoever = anyone who，引导主语从句；“几乎不”= can hardly。

q61.sampleAnswer: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole project.
references: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole project.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “, which...”指代前面整件事，引导非限制性定语从句；“导致”= lead to；spend time on sth.。

q62.sampleAnswer: He has such a strong will that he is sure to make every effort and try to finish the task in advance.
references: He has such a strong will that he is sure to make every effort and try to finish the task in advance.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: will 作名词“意志”；such a + 形容词 + 名词 + that...“如此……以至于”；“不遗余力”= make every effort；“提前”= in advance。

q63.sampleAnswer: Although Steve Jobs has left us, his creative ideas will always have great influence on the whole world.
references: Although Steve Jobs has left us, his creative ideas will always have great influence on the whole world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “整个世界”= the whole world；“对……有影响”= have influence on；“尽管”= although。

q64.sampleAnswer: While I admit that the problems are difficult, I don’t agree that they cannot be solved.
references: While I admit that the problems are difficult, I don’t agree that they cannot be solved.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: while 放在句首表示让步“虽然”；“不能被解决”用被动 cannot be solved。

q65.sampleAnswer: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
references: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “随着……”= with...；“被广泛使用”= be widely used；“世界各地”= all over the world。

q66.sampleAnswer: Whether you will go on an excursion or participate in a sports event, you had better take health insurance into consideration.
references: Whether you will go on an excursion or participate in a sports event, you had better take health insurance into consideration.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: whether...or...“无论是……还是……”；“最好”= had better do；“把……考虑在内”= take...into consideration。
